vectors.name: Vectors: Direction + Magnitude = Everything
vectors.truth: Direction + magnitude = vector. Decomposition reveals hidden structure. Every motion, every force, every relationship in space is a vector.
vectors.qfep_connection: Vectors define system states—the S in QFEP. They are how we measure and describe the world: position, velocity, force, direction. Without vectors, we cannot speak about change.
vectors.formula: v = (x, y, z), |v| = √(x² + y² + z²), v̂ = v/|v|
vectors.demonstration: Add vectors head-to-tail. See dot product measure alignment. Watch cross product create perpendicular vectors. Decompose complex motion into components.
vectors.description: The fundamental language of 3D space. Vectors encode direction and magnitude—the building blocks of physics, graphics, and simulation. Master vectors, master space.
